ContextMenu_LGTankerFuelBridge_Direction: Click to swap the transfer direction. The barrel's square must have electricity for fuel transfer.
ContextMenu_LGTankerFuelBridge_Tooltip: When a supported fuel tanker is parked within the configured range, this powered LG Extended Plumbing barrel receives up to the configured amount of petrol every 10 in-game minutes. It will not replace other liquids. Change the range and rate in Sandbox Options.
ContextMenu_LGTankerFuelBridge_DrainTool: Transfers up to the configured amount of petrol from this barrel into a nearby parked supported tanker every 10 in-game minutes. The barrel must be powered, contain petrol only, and the tanker needs free fuel-tank capacity.
